qualifiers.condition: The CloudWatch concepts page names only 10 seconds or 30 seconds as high-resolution alarm periods.

evidence.quote: If the alarm period is 10 seconds, 20 seconds, or 30 seconds, the alarm is evaluated every 10 seconds.

If you set an alarm on a high-resolution metric, you can specify a high-resolution alarm with a period of 10 seconds or 30 seconds, or you can set a regular alarm with a period of any multiple of 60 seconds.
